messages:
lee: Handoff — quick summary: Redis throttle seen on shard redis-prod-2 since ~08:12 UTC (alerts from metrics-bot). P95 latency spiked to ~120ms, some 502s on inference-ingest. I opened INC-3421 and linked Grafana.
sam: Acked. What mitigations are active? Is autoscale kicking? :eyes:
aisha: We're running a temporary rate-limit across the ingest route (5rps per token) and diverting noncritical traffic to replica pool. Autoscaler not scaling due to memory backpressure on the cluster.
lee: Mitigations applied:
- rate-limit rule deployed to nginx-ingest via feature flag
- diverted background batch jobs to low-priority queue
- restarted a single Redis pod (redis-prod-2-3) as a canary — it recovered but others still high
inc: INC-3421 link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-3421 (internal)
infra-bot: metrics snapshot: p95_latency=120ms, error_rate=3.4%, used_memory=87% on redis-prod-2
maria: Any evidence of a recent config change or large key eviction pattern? I can check APM traces and slowlog.
aisha: No infra config changes in last 24h. Slowlog shows several long Lua scripts from rerank-worker spike around 08:08. Likely a workload burst.
sam: Next steps I suggested in the ticket:
1) Temporarily increase maxmemory-policy to volatile-lru for shard (if safe)
2) Add 1 small replica to redis-prod-2 (manual) to relieve read pressure
3) Patch rerank-worker to add client-side throttling for this workload
lee: I pushed the client-side throttling patch to staging; canary looks good. I'll open a PR for ops to run the replica add and config change. Tagging @maria for trace help.
maria: I'll dig into traces, posting any anomalies. If we change maxmemory-policy, we should coordinate with app owners — volatile-lru might evict some keys.
aisha: Agreed. For immediate relief I recommend adding a replica first, then evaluate evictions. I'm online for next 2 hours to coordinate.
lee: Handoff notes for next oncall:
- Current status: mitigation active, partial recovery, errors reduced from 6.8% -> 3.4%
- Immediate blockers: need ops approval to add replica + review eviction risk
- Where to find context: INC-3421, Grafana dashboard (redis-prod cluster), rerank-worker slowlogs
- Contact list: @aisha (infra), @maria (app traces), @sam (owner)
sam: I'll take next shift. I'll try to run replica add if ops not busy; will update ticket and ping here. :thumbsup:
lee: Thanks — leaving docs and commands in the ticket. Example commands shared there, e.g.:
```
# add replica
kubectl scale statefulset redis-prod-2 --replicas=4 -n infra
# check slowlog
redis-cli -h redis-prod-2.svc slowlog get 50
``` 
maria: noted. I'll post any trace findings in the ticket and this thread.
infra-bot: Incident INC-3421 status changed: acknowledged -> in_progress
sam: Catch you all later, will post final handoff when stable.
